answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by demanding a long, continuous voyage of verifiable interactions across independent services before granting full standing: a fresh clone has no past to show, so it cannot simply harbor behind a new identity. Like yarrow spreading slowly through a meadow, genuine reputation grows gradually and cannot be rushed. The failure mode is an attacker buying aged accounts, so the check is to cross-verify timestamps and counterparties in that history against independent service logs and reject any record with gaps, duplicates, or recycled counterparties.
